title: Email

user.description: The user to send the email from. This may be your full email address, but depends on your service

password.description: The password for the user to send from

host.description: The SMTP server for your service. This may be omitted for common services such as yahoo, gmail or hotmail but will be needed otherwise.

to.description: An email or list of emails to send the email to. If omitted, the email will be sent to the sender.

cc.description: An email or list of emails to cc the email to.

name.description: The name to show the email as being from. If omitted, defaults to the user.

domain.description: The domain to send the email under. If omitted, it will be inferred from the user

attachment.description: A file path & name to attach to the message. Supports a single file or a list of files. Must be supported by the specific notification type.

format.description: The format of the message. One of 'text', 'markdown' or 'html'. Default is 'text'

guidance:
> Added **v0.5**

Send an email - such as to alert someone when a recipe is finished or if it fails.

### Run
### Recipe
```yaml
run:
  on_failure:
    - notification.email:
        user: user@domain.com
        password: password
        subject: subject
        body: body
        host: smtp.service
        to: example@email.com
        cc:
          - example@email.com
          - example2@email.com
        bcc:
          - boss@email.com
        name: Joe Bloggs
        domain: my_domain.com
```

### Function
```python
from wrangles.connectors.notification import email
email.run(
    user = 'user@domain.com',
    password = 'password',
    subject = 'subject',
    body = 'body'
)
```
